tldr: For a one-response continuous-dose independent exact-spike Voigt benchmark, the delivered result is a forced transition skeleton and a certified all-signal value/localization package. There is an attained first noncorner optimum, where a corner and a separated noncorner action coexist, and an attained last endpoint optimum, where an endpoint and a separated unequal-dose action coexist. Before the first threshold only corners maximize; after the last, every maximizer has unequal nonzero amplitudes. The thresholds may coincide. Rational-input optimum brackets and epsilon-optimal actions have explicit errors, and a sufficient high-signal cutoff gives strict exterior-dose exclusion and quantitative loss bounds. Complete transition count and order, all coexistence sets, balanced differentiated localization, and exhaustive branch exclusion remain open. This benchmark is distinct from published DABS, with no model inclusion or converse transfer.
